note: Set A presents six distinct, correctly bound claims, including the Title 24 requirement that high efficacy luminaires be connected to their own switch in the kitchen, bathroom, closet and laundry rooms. Set B repeats the 40W incandescent power claim and the vacancy-sensor bypass requirement verbatim under slightly reworded conditions/values, adding no new information. Set B also omits the own-switch connection requirement that A captures. Both sets read the wattages, the T24 fixture requirement and the vacancy-sensor condition correctly.
remarks: Both sets ignore the LIGHTING LEVELS table in the page image (3 FC general use/movement with 40W bulb at half power; 5-10 FC simple tasks with 40W bulb; 30 FC large size or high construct with (4) 40W bulbs; 50 FC small size or visually complex with (6) 40W bulbs, tied to walking bedroom-to-bathroom, making coffee, chopping vegetables, reading the newspaper) — these are substantive engineering facts present on the page and omitted by both extractions. Set B's duplicates appear to be the same underlying fact emitted twice with trivially different wording.
